definitions.gloss: one's own child; biological child; natural child
definitions.explanation: A child who is biologically related to their parent, as opposed to an adopted or step-child. A legal and formal term.

examples.japanese: {実子|じっし}と{養子|ようし}の{区別|くべつ}はない。
examples.english: There is no distinction between biological and adopted children.

examples.japanese: {法律上|ほうりつじょう}、{実子|じっし}も{養子|ようし}も{同|おな}じ{相続権|そうぞくけん}を{持|も}つ。
examples.english: Legally, both biological and adopted children have the same inheritance rights.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{実子|じっし}のように{可愛|かわい}がっている{養子|ようし}がいる。
examples.english: He has an adopted child whom he cherishes as if they were his own.

notes:
A formal/legal term for a biological child. In everyday conversation, people would simply say {自分|じぶん}の{子|こ} (one's own child). {実子|じっし} appears primarily in legal, medical, and formal contexts.

WATCH OUT:
Not to be confused with {実施|じっし} (implementation, carrying out), which has the same reading.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {実子|じっし}と{養子|ようし}: biological and adopted children
- {実子|じっし}のように: as if one's own child
- {実子|じっし}{同様|どうよう}: same as a biological child

RELATED WORDS:
- {養子|ようし}: adopted child
- {継子|ままこ}: stepchild
- {里子|さとご}: foster child
- {実親|じつおや}: biological parent
- {養親|ようしん}: adoptive parent
